findings.rationale: Accepted: pid 1 inside the namespace is bwrap's reaper, a wrapper cannot clean it. Probed `bwrap --args 9` on this host → /proc/1/cmdline is exactly `bwrap --args 9 -- /bin/sh …` with no host path. §1.3 now passes every option through an args file, the argv assertion is 'no host path in pid-1 argv' with a no-`--args` control (§1.5 (a), §4 boundary, R4).

Accepted: dispatch precondition now runs `--preflight --deny-path <packet dir>` (ms, no model) and a non-zero exit is die_precondition `cleanroom runtime unusable`; header notes AUTOPILOT_CLEANROOM_BWRAP must be AppArmor-permitted (§1.2, §1.6, §2.6).

Accepted: no outer timeout around the launcher (its timer is the only wall cap, 124 unambiguous); launcher traps EXIT INT TERM HUP and re-raises after cleanup; seat roots use a fixed `cleanroom-seat.` prefix and dispatch-review passes --seat-root beside the packet; orphan note in header (§1.3, §1.4, §6).

Accepted: §4 no-regression row and §4.1 now say the seven pre-existing commands are green at base and the new suite is recorded as `absent at base (created by this cut)`; the base evidence file already has that line.

Accepted: resolution defined as `command -v` → `readlink -f`, regular file, `codex-code-mode-host` beside it, else exit 2 `codex binary directory unresolved`; portable stub test (g) added (§1.2, §1.5, §1.6).

Accepted: §5 dogfood records sha256 of ~/.codex/auth.json before/after and re-authenticates; limitation stated in the launcher header and blind-dispatch 'not proven' list; stale last_refresh preflight refusal deferred to 1b-B (§3).

Accepted: scripts inside the boundary run via /bin/sh explicitly and dispatch-review passes --seat-root next to the packet (blind dir) instead of host TMPDIR; host /tmp here is rw,relatime (recorded) (§0, §1.3).
Accepted: preflight mode contract stated — only --deny-path (+ optional --bwrap/--seat-root), empty work dir, no credential/binary/packet, JSON line with profile 'preflight' (§1.3, §4 preflight row).
Accepted as recorded follow-up (no change this cut): proxy/CA env pass-through listed in §1.3 and §3 for the first proxied host; this host is not proxied.
